title: Understanding the Logistic Function
text: The logistic function, also known as the sigmoid function, is used to model probabilities. It transforms any real-valued number into a value between $$0$$ and $$1$$. The formula is given by $$sigma(z)=\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-z\right)}}$$.

title: Calculate the Linear Combination
text: To find the value of $$z$$ in the logistic function, calculate the linear combination of the features and the parameters: $$z=\theta_1 hue+\theta_2 abv$$. Substitute the given values for hue and abv.

title: Substitute the Values
text: Given $$\theta_1=2$$, $$\theta_2=1$$, $$hue=\frac{1}{4}$$, and $$abv=-2$$, substitute these into the linear combination formula: $$z=2\frac{1}{4}+1\left(-2\right)$$.

title: Evaluate the Exponential
text: Once you have $$z$$, calculate $$e^{\left(-z\right)}$$. This will be used in the logistic function to find the probability.

title: Calculate $$e^{\left(-z\right)}$$
text: What is the value of $$e^{\left(-z\right)}$$ when $$z=\frac{-3}{2}$$?

title: Find the Probability
text: Use the logistic function to find the probability: $$gamma=\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-z\right)}}$$. Substitute the value of $$e^{\left(-z\right)}$$ you calculated.
